_comment: Generated by cdk/generate_pipeline_config.py after `cdk deploy`. Do not hand-edit. This example shows the shape; real values come from your account's stack outputs. image_uri is normally the digest-pinned form the CodeBuild image factory publishes to SSM (<repo>@sha256:...); a tag-addressed form as shown also works.
_extra_job_tags_comment: Optional. Added to every training job. If your account runs cost-cleanup tooling that stops resources on a schedule, put its exemption tag here — a job queued for scarce GPU capacity can otherwise be stopped while still Pending, with no FailureReason. Example: {"auto-stop": "no", "auto-delete": "never"}
